NVIDIA's GM107 GPU uses the Maxwell architecture and is made using a 28 nm production process at TSMC. With a die size of 148 mm² and a transistor count of 1.87 billion it is an average sized chip. GM107 supports DirectX 12 (Feature Level 11_0). It also supports OpenGL 4.6 and Vulkan 1.4. For GPU compute applications, OpenCL version 3.0 and CUDA 5.0 can be used. It features 640 shading units, 40 texture mapping units and 16 ROPs.
Further reading: GM107 Architecture Whitepaper
